headline: An account-planning agent inside Microsoft Copilot
summary: After connecting the Backstory MCP, the team saw an account-planning agent in Copilot generate account-plan briefs, pipeline analysis, and territory design from Backstory's account status, scorecards, engaged people, and open opportunities.
next: Their first ask: account-level engagement and activity summaries delivered in Microsoft Teams.

headline: A deal-analysis agent built on a defined opportunity set
summary: They built an agent that filters a defined set of opportunities, for example deals over $100K that meet close-date criteria, then produces a deal analysis for each. The flow runs end to end.
next: Next: using their own customers' feedback to decide which fields and questions to expand.

headline: Territory intelligence for GMs and territory leaders
summary: A clearly defined territory-intelligence use case: business briefings for general managers, a view of the least-active reps, conversion and territory views, and account-takeover plans that combine opportunity, activity, and public-signal context.
next: Designed and waiting on Copilot and gateway approval before a live rollout.

headline: Finding overlapping accounts across two CRMs
summary: A prospect wants to identify accounts that appear in two separate CRM instances, to coordinate teams and find upsell opportunities. A working demo is being scoped.
next: Comparing whole CRMs runs into MCP record limits, so large, repeatable jobs like this one are often a better fit for the API.
